[P2] Document the breaking configuration change in the changelog

Removing `timeout` makes existing typed configuration literals containing it fail TypeScript's excess-property check. The PR acknowledges this breaking change, but the diff has no `CHANGELOG.md` entry. Root `AGENTS.md` Pull requests rule 3 requires an entry under `## [Unreleased]`, with no experimental-API exemption. Add an experimental breaking-change entry explaining that callers must remove the session-level timeout and retain their per-job timeouts.
